name: S²-Guidance (random block skip, subtract, renormalize)
plain: An extra positive pass with random blocks skipped, subtracted with a weight, then renormalized to the CFG output norm. The block count per step is random, and it supports many DiT layouts.
math:
n_skip = int(⌈p/100⌉·B) (see surprise)
x̂_s = M(x; c, skip random blocks)
R = x̂_cfg − w·x̂_s
x̂ = R·‖x̂_cfg‖/‖R‖ (whole tensor norm)
label: from code
surprise: The ceil wraps only pct/100, so any percent in 1..100 gives ceil=1 and every block is skipped. The percentage has no effect beyond 0.
